pages.title: O que não se sente
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT sits with his RIGHT hand wrapped on his lap, Runa RIGHT seated nearby listening; her hands folded on her own lap, no touching injured hand, stone infirmary and warm cup.
pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT sits with his RIGHT hand wrapped on his lap, Runa RIGHT seated nearby listening; her hands folded on her own lap, no touching injured hand, stone infirmary and warm cup.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Está doendo?

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: É não sentir que me assusta.

pages.title: O formigamento
pages.scene: Close medium Ilyan alone, looking down at cloth-wrapped RIGHT hand resting on blanket, LEFT hand holds cup by handle. Expression relief mixed with fear. No magic.
pages.layout: Close medium Ilyan alone, looking down at cloth-wrapped RIGHT hand resting on blanket, LEFT hand holds cup by handle. Expression relief mixed with fear. No magic.
pages.narration: A sensibilidade voltou devagar. O dedo mínimo continuava dolorido.

pages.title: Duas linhas
pages.scene: Ilyan alone at cedar desk writing in notebook with uninjured LEFT hand, wrapped RIGHT hand resting visibly on desk edge. Lamp ordinary. Side profile, no readable lettering.
pages.layout: Ilyan alone at cedar desk writing in notebook with uninjured LEFT hand, wrapped RIGHT hand resting visibly on desk edge. Lamp ordinary. Side profile, no readable lettering.
pages.narration: No caderno, riscou a frase heroica. Quisera continuar porque estava bonito.

pages.title: Bonito também fere
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT walk slowly toward refectory, her RIGHT hand holds his LEFT hand naturally between bodies; tattooed LEFT hand at own side, his RIGHT wrapped hand close to torso.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT walk slowly toward refectory, her RIGHT hand holds his LEFT hand naturally between bodies; tattooed LEFT hand at own side, his RIGHT wrapped hand close to torso.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Uma coisa bonita ainda pode ferir você.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Sei agora um pouco melhor.

pages.title: O banco ocupado
pages.scene: Tovo alone at kitchen doorway, anatomical RIGHT arm entirely in single cream sling, LEFT hand empty by side, assigned portion ledger on small table. Empty kitchen tools not extra people.
pages.layout: Tovo alone at kitchen doorway, anatomical RIGHT arm entirely in single cream sling, LEFT hand empty by side, assigned portion ledger on small table. Empty kitchen tools not extra people.
pages.narration: Suas tarefas tinham sido distribuídas. O banco de cortar legumes já não o esperava.

pages.title: O cesto fica
pages.scene: Tovo seated beside a LOW basket on floor, free LEFT hand released basket handle, injured RIGHT contained sling; concerned expression, no lifting and no magic. Exactly two arms.
pages.layout: Tovo seated beside a LOW basket on floor, free LEFT hand released basket handle, injured RIGHT contained sling; concerned expression, no lifting and no magic. Exactly two arms.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Nem precisei usar magia para sentir puxar.

pages.title: Tendão não é pedra
pages.scene: Tovo LEFT seated with right sling, tiny Oru RIGHT on same floor by low table with wooden spoon resting on two blocks. Oru one hand points toward spoon, other at own belt. No hand crossing.
pages.layout: Tovo LEFT seated with right sling, tiny Oru RIGHT on same floor by low table with wooden spoon resting on two blocks. Oru one hand points toward spoon, other at own belt. No hand crossing.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Estraguei a minha magia?

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: O impulso aumenta. O tendão não vira pedra.

pages.title: Por onde seguir
pages.scene: Tovo LEFT seated with right sling and ledger, free left hand resting beside charcoal route sketch; Ilyan RIGHT seated with wrapped right hand resting on own lap and bread in left. Kitchen simple shelves.
pages.layout: Tovo LEFT seated with right sling and ledger, free left hand resting beside charcoal route sketch; Ilyan RIGHT seated with wrapped right hand resting on own lap and bread in left. Kitchen simple shelves.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: E se descobrirem que não precisam de mim?

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Também me mandaram sentar.

pages.title: Três fitas
pages.scene: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT beside three wind ribbons at doorway, between columns and above basin, ribbons moving in DIFFERENT directions. Both hands at own sides. Open school practice court.
pages.layout: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT beside three wind ribbons at doorway, between columns and above basin, ribbons moving in DIFFERENT directions. Both hands at own sides. Open school practice court.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Tem vento para atravessar o pátio.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Olhe de novo a fita do meio.

pages.title: Interromper a corrente
pages.scene: Caio alone side view, ONE left arm raised open hand controlling small existing airflow at ribbon, right arm lowered. He stops before steam-tray crossing path outside frame, no person drawn.
pages.layout: Caio alone side view, ONE left arm raised open hand controlling small existing airflow at ribbon, right arm lowered. He stops before steam-tray crossing path outside frame, no person drawn.
pages.narration: Caio interrompeu ao perceber alguém entrando no alcance do exercício.

pages.title: A dobradiça
pages.scene: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT sit beside garden wall; Sere looks back anxiously at distant ordinary wooden doorway, her one hand on own bow strap, other on lap. Caio waits quietly.
pages.layout: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT sit beside garden wall; Sere looks back anxiously at distant ordinary wooden doorway, her one hand on own bow strap, other on lap. Caio waits quietly.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Às vezes espero ouvir minha voz onde não há ninguém.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Quer sair daqui?

pages.title: Uma tarde possível
pages.scene: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT seated same bench, gentle closed-mouth kiss, fully clothed, each both hands rest on own lap, Caio bag on ground. Canonical adult elf Sere, no magic.
pages.layout: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT seated same bench, gentle closed-mouth kiss, fully clothed, each both hands rest on own lap, Caio bag on ground. Canonical adult elf Sere, no magic.
pages.narration: A feira ainda estava longe. Já havia lugar para ela nos planos dos dois.

pages.title: O som das ferramentas
pages.scene: Adult tiny Nima LEFT stands at threshold of Bram forge with tool case on ground; Bram RIGHT kneels on one knee to her eye level smiling welcome, both hands resting on own knees; Nima hand at toolbelt. Warm workshop.
pages.layout: Adult tiny Nima LEFT stands at threshold of Bram forge with tool case on ground; Bram RIGHT kneels on one knee to her eye level smiling welcome, both hands resting on own knees; Nima hand at toolbelt. Warm workshop.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Aram é uma pista. Ainda não sabemos onde Mira está.

pages.title: O gesto de Bram
pages.scene: Nima LEFT standing on a stable work platform reaching low workbench, Bram RIGHT standing looking troubled, one hand gripping table edge other hanging at side. Cooling hearth behind. No magic.
pages.layout: Nima LEFT standing on a stable work platform reaching low workbench, Bram RIGHT standing looking troubled, one hand gripping table edge other hanging at side. Cooling hearth behind. No magic.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Ele acendeu fogo na própria palma.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Preciso ler a carta do meu filho.

pages.title: A bomba da praça
pages.scene: Tiny adult Nima alone standing full body beside ordinary public hand pump, using ONE small wrench on low mechanism, other hand rests on own belt, tools in open case on paving, repair work not magical.
pages.layout: Tiny adult Nima alone standing full body beside ordinary public hand pump, using ONE small wrench on low mechanism, other hand rests on own belt, tools in open case on paving, repair work not magical.
pages.narration: A casa, os clientes e a bancada continuavam sendo seus.

pages.title: Duas folhas
pages.scene: Adult Nima alone at appropriately scaled own desk in village home, writing separate letters with ONE pen, other hand holding paper flat, goggles and cap on chair nearby, copper curly bob and adult face visible.
pages.layout: Adult Nima alone at appropriately scaled own desk in village home, writing separate letters with ONE pen, other hand holding paper flat, goggles and cap on chair nearby, copper curly bob and adult face visible.
pages.narration: Escreveu para os dois. Saudade não precisava transformar sua vida numa espera.

pages.title: O ferro escurece
pages.scene: Bram LEFT holds cooling iron bar in tongs over anvil, Nima RIGHT on fixed work platform watches dark ceramic-wrapped scrap in stone tray. Exactly two arms each, clear separate tools, no flame casting.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT holds cooling iron bar in tongs over anvil, Nima RIGHT on fixed work platform watches dark ceramic-wrapped scrap in stone tray. Exactly two arms each, clear separate tools, no flame casting.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Ela perdeu o brilho antes de chegar à bigorna.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Afaste o resto da carga.

pages.title: Comparação pequena
pages.scene: Nima alone on safe standing platform watches TWO identical cups of warm water on stone table, one cup near a dark ceramic-broken metal fragment in stone tray and other farther away; she holds a wooden pointer in one hand, other on own belt.
pages.layout: Nima alone on safe standing platform watches TWO identical cups of warm water on stone table, one cup near a dark ceramic-broken metal fragment in stone tray and other farther away; she holds a wooden pointer in one hand, other on own belt.
pages.narration: A caneca próxima esfriou primeiro. Nima encerrou o teste.

pages.title: O mesmo lote
pages.scene: Bram LEFT and tiny Nima RIGHT compare unlettered shipping ledger and sketch at low bench, Bram open palm near ledger, Nima points with ONE pencil at copper ring sketch. Scrap tray isolated on floor.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT and tiny Nima RIGHT compare unlettered shipping ledger and sketch at low bench, Bram open palm near ledger, Nima points with ONE pencil at copper ring sketch. Scrap tray isolated on floor.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Parte dessa sucata foi para a escola.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: O aviso segue pela posta hoje.

pages.title: O nome no frio
pages.scene: Nima LEFT standing on platform and Bram RIGHT at quiet forge bench, Nima worried face looks up to Bram; Bram sits heavily both hands on own knees. Distance between them palpable, cold hearth.
pages.layout: Nima LEFT standing on platform and Bram RIGHT at quiet forge bench, Nima worried face looks up to Bram; Bram sits heavily both hands on own knees. Distance between them palpable, cold hearth.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Conheço esse frio no corpo de Mira.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Não leve essa resposta incompleta ao seu filho.

pages.title: Duas bancadas
pages.scene: Runa LEFT at low water basin, Liria RIGHT at existing stone support with notebook brass chain at belt, separate school evaluation benches and mechanical gate between. Both hostile expressions, no friendly gesture. Hands low on own respective bench.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT at low water basin, Liria RIGHT at existing stone support with notebook brass chain at belt, separate school evaluation benches and mechanical gate between. Both hostile expressions, no friendly gesture. Hands low on own respective bench.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Não altere a minha medida.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Não vou deixar o tanque transbordar.

pages.title: A ameaça ouvida
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Liria RIGHT stand at separate stone benches hands withdrawn away from devices; Liria narrowed eyes and hard mouth, Runa tense alert looking toward exit to LEFT. Tiny water spill below, no fight.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Liria RIGHT stand at separate stone benches hands withdrawn away from devices; Liria narrowed eyes and hard mouth, Runa tense alert looking toward exit to LEFT. Tiny water spill below, no fight.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Aprendeu a se esconder atrás dos outros.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Repita isso diante da professora.

pages.title: O registro distingue
pages.scene: Avel LEFT facing Liria RIGHT, Avel hand held low firm STOP gesture below chest, other hand at ledger. Liria both hands at sides with brass chain notebook. School evaluation archway.
pages.layout: Avel LEFT facing Liria RIGHT, Avel hand held low firm STOP gesture below chest, other hand at ledger. Liria both hands at sides with brass chain notebook. School evaluation archway.

lines.speaker: Avel
lines.text: O exercício acabou. Vou registrar o que foi dito.

pages.title: Companhia
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT pause beside hallway exit; Runa tattooed left hand clenched at own side, right hand holds his left. Ilyan right hand still lightly cloth-protected. No Liria visible.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT pause beside hallway exit; Runa tattooed left hand clenched at own side, right hand holds his left. Ilyan right hand still lightly cloth-protected. No Liria visible.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Não vá atrás dela. Quero alguém que me escute.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Eu vou com você.

pages.title: O barro da posta
pages.scene: Ordelia LEFT behind archive counter hands TWO closed letters to Ilyan RIGHT. Both faces clear, one normal hand each involved, other arms at own side, no extra people.
pages.layout: Ordelia LEFT behind archive counter hands TWO closed letters to Ilyan RIGHT. Both faces clear, one normal hand each involved, other arms at own side, no extra people.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: O aviso vai para a forja. Estas cartas são suas.

pages.title: Antes da pergunta
pages.scene: Tiny Oru LEFT stands on same floor beside stone tray of unopened ceramic-wrapped scrap, Ilyan RIGHT human standing; low worktable. Both keep hands away from fragments.
pages.layout: Tiny Oru LEFT stands on same floor beside stone tray of unopened ceramic-wrapped scrap, Ilyan RIGHT human standing; low worktable. Both keep hands away from fragments.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Meu pai lembrou de Mira.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Primeiro, precisamos isolar essas peças.

pages.title: Palavras próprias
pages.scene: Runa alone by cedar-room window reads Nima separate letter, paper held only in RIGHT hand, tattooed LEFT hand on own lap. Ordinary daylight, reflective expression.
pages.layout: Runa alone by cedar-room window reads Nima separate letter, paper held only in RIGHT hand, tattooed LEFT hand on own lap. Ordinary daylight, reflective expression.
pages.narration: Escreveu de volta sem esperar que a resposta chegasse naquela noite.

pages.title: A pergunta guardada
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT and Runa RIGHT sit across small cedar desk with opened letters, hands at own sides. His eyes angry and confused, she calm but firm.
pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT and Runa RIGHT sit across small cedar desk with opened letters, hands at own sides. His eyes angry and confused, she calm but firm.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Nima fez perguntas. Bram ainda precisa responder.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Quero perguntar por que esperou tanto.

pages.title: Uma saída com tarefas
pages.scene: Eda LEFT gives Ilyan RIGHT a folded travel permission at archive desk, separate sample containers ceramic sealed low on table. Ilyan holds healed right hand relaxed, no bandage now after medical check.
pages.layout: Eda LEFT gives Ilyan RIGHT a folded travel permission at archive desk, separate sample containers ceramic sealed low on table. Ilyan holds healed right hand relaxed, no bandage now after medical check.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Viajaremos com a carroça de suprimentos.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Sem fogo corporal durante o caminho.

pages.title: Onde o encaixe quebra
pages.scene: Tovo LEFT seated right sling, free left hand offers an unlettered handle-mechanism sketch to Ilyan RIGHT standing at kitchen door. Tovo no lifting.
pages.layout: Tovo LEFT seated right sling, free left hand offers an unlettered handle-mechanism sketch to Ilyan RIGHT standing at kitchen door. Tovo no lifting.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Mostre a Bram. Quero saber onde essa alça quebra.

pages.title: A última palavra
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Liria RIGHT stand apart in archive corridor, Runa travel bag and roll at side, Liria chain-bound notebook. Hostility, no smiles, no touch.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Liria RIGHT stand apart in archive corridor, Runa travel bag and roll at side, Liria chain-bound notebook. Hostility, no smiles, no touch.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: A viagem é recompensa pela prova interrompida?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: É trabalho. Não vou discutir minha visita.

pages.title: Uma tarde reservada
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT seated beside packed travel bag, Runa RIGHT seated facing him on separate chair, both fully clothed, her tattoo left arm and straight bangs preserved, his hands ownknees.
pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT seated beside packed travel bag, Runa RIGHT seated facing him on separate chair, both fully clothed, her tattoo left arm and straight bangs preserved, his hands ownknees.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Não quero chegar como figurante da sua discussão.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: O que você quer fazer na visita?

pages.title: A roda frouxa
pages.scene: Eda LEFT standing observes Ilyan RIGHT kneeling beside stopped ordinary wagon wheel, he holds wooden wedge in right hand, left hand on own knee, tools on ground. No unsupported wagon or magic.
pages.layout: Eda LEFT standing observes Ilyan RIGHT kneeling beside stopped ordinary wagon wheel, he holds wooden wedge in right hand, left hand on own knee, tools on ground. No unsupported wagon or magic.
pages.narration: A primeira manhã perdeu tempo com uma roda. A distância continuava sendo distância.

pages.title: Saudade não é prova
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT walk side by side along plain rural road, wagon far behind empty-looking. Hands ownbelts, naturallegs fullbody.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT walk side by side along plain rural road, wagon far behind empty-looking. Hands ownbelts, naturallegs fullbody.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: E se a visita virar uma disputa de saudade?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Não pretendo medir afeto assim.

pages.title: A caixa da montanha
pages.scene: Eda alone kneels near CLOSED ceramic-wrapped cargo box at ordinary roadside post, copies simple geometric maker mark to notebook with one pencil, not readable text. No opening, no mysterious person.
pages.layout: Eda alone kneels near CLOSED ceramic-wrapped cargo box at ordinary roadside post, copies simple geometric maker mark to notebook with one pencil, not readable text. No opening, no mysterious person.
pages.narration: O vendedor indicou um depósito nas montanhas. Eda anotou para conferir.

pages.title: A coisa que ela fez
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT standing before village hand pump with newly repaired brass linkage. Runa points one RIGHT finger to low mechanism, tattooLEFT handatbeltside, Ilyan smiles faintly. Both travelbags.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT standing before village hand pump with newly repaired brass linkage. Runa points one RIGHT finger to low mechanism, tattooLEFT handatbeltside, Ilyan smiles faintly. Both travelbags.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: É a bomba que Nima descreveu na carta.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A oficina fica na próxima curva.

pages.title: Antes das palavras
pages.scene: Runa LEFT KNEELS to adult tiny Nima RIGHT at village workshop threshold, gentle brief closed-mouth kiss, both smiling, Runa hands own knees, Nima one hand on Runa shoulder other at toolbelt. Nima actual90cm adult, Runa kneeling makes faces meet. Exactly2arms each.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT KNEELS to adult tiny Nima RIGHT at village workshop threshold, gentle brief closed-mouth kiss, both smiling, Runa hands own knees, Nima one hand on Runa shoulder other at toolbelt. Nima actual90cm adult, Runa kneeling makes faces meet. Exactly2arms each.
pages.narration: Runa se abaixou antes que Nima precisasse escolher por quem começar.

pages.title: Também chegou
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT KNEELS on dry ground to adult90cm Nima RIGHT standing. Gentle closed-mouth kiss, fully clothed, his hands own knees, Nima right hand gently holds edge of his indigo vest, other handatbelt. NO Runa visible and no otherpeople.
pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT KNEELS on dry ground to adult90cm Nima RIGHT standing. Gentle closed-mouth kiss, fully clothed, his hands own knees, Nima right hand gently holds edge of his indigo vest, other handatbelt. NO Runa visible and no otherpeople.
pages.narration: Quando Nima o puxou pelo colete, Ilyan se ajoelhou e a beijou também.

pages.title: Nesta visita
pages.scene: Bram LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT stand at forge doorway, father hands resting on son's shoulders, Ilyan bothhands atownside. Fatheradult47strongdarkwarmbrownlongtiedhairshortgreybeard not baldTeren. Emotional hesitant welcome.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT stand at forge doorway, father hands resting on son's shoulders, Ilyan bothhands atownside. Fatheradult47strongdarkwarmbrownlongtiedhairshortgreybeard not baldTeren. Emotional hesitant welcome.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Tenho perguntas.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Vamos comer. Não vou adiar para outra viagem.

pages.title: Já conhecia a praça
pages.scene: Runa LEFT seated on low public bench and adult tiny Nima RIGHT beside her same bench, Nima feet rest on footstool not floating, pumpsquare behind. Runa gentlylooksdownNima, hands separateonownlaps.
pages.layout: Runa LEFT seated on low public bench and adult tiny Nima RIGHT beside her same bench, Nima feet rest on footstool not floating, pumpsquare behind. Runa gentlylooksdownNima, hands separateonownlaps.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Reconheci a bomba antes de encontrar você.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Escrevi detalhes demais?

pages.narration: Runa gostara de encontrar um lugar que já conhecia por ter escutado Nima.

pages.title: A lua torta
pages.scene: Bram LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT seated at kitchen table, small old copper buckle with crooked crescent engraving centered on tabletop, both both hands flat on own tableedges, troubled expressions.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT seated at kitchen table, small old copper buckle with crooked crescent engraving centered on tabletop, both both hands flat on own tableedges, troubled expressions.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Sua mãe voltou gelada, semanas antes de desaparecer.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: E você nunca me contou.

pages.title: Uma noite doméstica
pages.scene: Bram alone close medium seated, looking toward old doorway and folded blankets on bench. In foreground small copper buckle on table. Present-day recollection, NO ghost and NO flashback Mira.
pages.layout: Bram alone close medium seated, looking toward old doorway and folded blankets on bench. In foreground small copper buckle on table. Present-day recollection, NO ghost and NO flashback Mira.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Chamamos a curandeira. Aquecemos a sala devagar.

pages.title: A bênção e o custo
pages.scene: Bram LEFT Ilyan RIGHT at same plain table, father points one finger toward own palm low overtable, son hands ownlap, old buckle visible. Faces angryandregretful no magic.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT Ilyan RIGHT at same plain table, father points one finger toward own palm low overtable, son hands ownlap, old buckle visible. Faces angryandregretful no magic.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: A bênção não tornava o corpo dela inesgotável.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Devia ter contado quando soube do meu fogo.

pages.title: O que ele desenhou
pages.scene: Close Ilyan alone holding small OLD copper buckle in ONE hand at chestheight, other handrestsontable; crooked little crescent engraving recognizable but no text, face conflicted, presentday not child.
pages.layout: Close Ilyan alone holding small OLD copper buckle in ONE hand at chestheight, other handrestsontable; crooked little crescent engraving recognizable but no text, face conflicted, presentday not child.
pages.narration: A lua fora feita por ele quando pequeno. A lembrança que a cercava era nova.

pages.title: Fique
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT Runa RIGHT sit at village pumpbench, apartbyhalfseat, his elbowsownkneeshandsclasped, her hands ownlap. Sad angry gaze, morning.
pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT Runa RIGHT sit at village pumpbench, apartbyhalfseat, his elbowsownkneeshandsclasped, her hands ownlap. Sad angry gaze, morning.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Parece que me mantiveram no lugar de uma criança.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Quer que eu fique?

pages.narration: Ilyan pediu que ela ficasse.

pages.title: Sem sentimento pronto
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT seated low stool, tinyadultNima RIGHT standing by own draftingtable sameground, she closes drawingbox withbothnormalhands. Quiet serious expression.
pages.layout: Ilyan LEFT seated low stool, tinyadultNima RIGHT standing by own draftingtable sameground, she closes drawingbox withbothnormalhands. Quiet serious expression.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Você acha que devo confiar nele?

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Posso ficar ao seu lado. Não escolher por você.

pages.title: Um lugar para conferir
pages.scene: Bram LEFT stands just inside guestroomdoor holding ONE paper with approximate timeline, Ilyan RIGHT seated bededge fullyclothed armsatownsides. Distanceandprivacy, no touch.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT stands just inside guestroomdoor holding ONE paper with approximate timeline, Ilyan RIGHT seated bededge fullyclothed armsatownsides. Distanceandprivacy, no touch.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: O papel não substitui a conversa.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Agora eu preciso que você saia.

pages.title: Ainda há louça
pages.scene: Bram LEFT washes bowl at kitchenbasin while Ilyan RIGHT carries ONE empty bowl withbothhands tocounter, shoulders tenseandquiet not cheerful reconciled.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT washes bowl at kitchenbasin while Ilyan RIGHT carries ONE empty bowl withbothhands tocounter, shoulders tenseandquiet not cheerful reconciled.
pages.narration: Não estavam reconciliados. Naquela noite, os dois ainda recolheram a mesa.

pages.title: O livro do depósito
pages.scene: Eda LEFT seated and tiny Nima RIGHT standing on secure low platform examine open merchant ledger and closed scrapcrate at warehouse low table. No other people. Eda handflatbook, Nimaholdsonepencil.
pages.layout: Eda LEFT seated and tiny Nima RIGHT standing on secure low platform examine open merchant ledger and closed scrapcrate at warehouse low table. No other people. Eda handflatbook, Nimaholdsonepencil.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Vieram de uma oficina antiga nas encostas de Aram.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: O vendedor aceitou suspender o restante.

pages.title: O pino ausente
pages.scene: Nima alone on safe platform at workbench, wooden pointer in one hand traces missing pin slot of broken ceramic casing and dark porous stone on dry stone tray, otherhandownbelt. NO explosive mechanism.
pages.layout: Nima alone on safe platform at workbench, wooden pointer in one hand traces missing pin slot of broken ceramic casing and dark porous stone on dry stone tray, otherhandownbelt. NO explosive mechanism.
pages.narration: O pino perdido deixara o caminho de calor sempre aberto.

pages.title: Nem tudo é dela
pages.scene: Nima LEFT on platform and Ilyan RIGHT seated beside bench, both same eyeheight, she points pencil toward OLD toolmarks on ceramic fragment, he listens hands onownknees.
pages.layout: Nima LEFT on platform and Ilyan RIGHT seated beside bench, both same eyeheight, she points pencil toward OLD toolmarks on ceramic fragment, he listens hands onownknees.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Mira fez isso?

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: As marcas são mais antigas que a passagem dela.

pages.title: Pensar juntos
pages.scene: Bram LEFT Ilyan RIGHT at forge bench jointly inspect wooden carrying handle sketch, each uses own separate tool low ontable, nooverlappingarms. Small ordinary handle between them.
pages.layout: Bram LEFT Ilyan RIGHT at forge bench jointly inspect wooden carrying handle sketch, each uses own separate tool low ontable, nooverlappingarms. Small ordinary handle between them.
pages.narration: A alça de Tovo ofereceu um trabalho que os dois ainda sabiam dividir.
